image_description: A top-down view of a dark blue, textured object resembling a compact cassette tape. The object has the general rectangular shape with rounded corners of a cassette. It features two circular cutouts and a central rectangular window, mimicking the spool windows of a real cassette. A paper label is affixed to the lower half with illegible, gibberish text that attempts to mimic track listings. The surface texture appears to be a coarse fabric or felt rather than smooth plastic, and the edges show signs of fraying or softness inconsistent with rigid plastic molding.

The functional interior of the cassette (spools, tape) is completely missing. The windows are just holes in a flat textured plane. The object is a hollow shell or a flat cutout, not a functional device.
The edges of the object appear slightly soft and irregular, lacking the sharp, straight lines expected from a molded plastic object. The corners are unevenly rounded.
